item.title: 2027 年 Medicare Advantage 和 D 部分星级评级
item.description: 2027 年 Medicare Advantage 和 D 部分星级 注：本情况说明书中包含的信息基于 2026 年 10 月 8 日在 Medicare Plan Finder 上发布的 2027 年 Medicare Advantage (MA) 和 D 部分星级评级。有关 MA 和 D 部分星级评级方法的详细信息，请参阅 2027 年 C 部分和 D 部分星级评级技术说明。确保 Medicare 为老年人和残疾人提供服务，并确保 Medicare 受益人能够获得强大、稳定、高质量和负担得起的选择来满足他们所需的保险范围，这是 Medicare 和 Medicaid 服务中心 (CMS) 的首要任务。

item.title: Stryker 向 CMR Surgical 投资 4 亿美元，进军软组织机器人领域
item.description: Stryker 周一表示，已与软组织机器人公司 CMR Surgical 合作，向该公司投资约 4 亿美元，并成为 CMR 系统的美国独家经销商。总部位于英国剑桥的 CMR 去年获得了美国食品和药物管理局的批准，其最新的机器人系统可以在美国执行胆囊手术。摩根大通分析师罗比·马库斯在一份研究报告中写道，截至 2026 年初，该公司已在全球执行了超过 45,000 例手术。 Stifel 分析师 Rick Wise 在一份研究报告中写道，多年来，史赛克一直被期望进入软组织机器人市场。怀斯补充道，随着竞争对手强生公司和美敦力公司在美国的机器人获得 FDA 批准，“对于史赛克来说，现在是时候做出决定了，机不可失。”

item.title: Quality Assessment and Model Training Impact of Synthetic Images in Medical Diagnostic Imaging: Systematic Review
item.description: Conclusions: Unlike previous reviews restricted to particular diseases, imaging modalities, or generative architectures, this review provides a cross-domain quantitative synthesis of both synthetic-image quality assessment and downstream model performance. Synthetic images currently appear more valuable as a complement to real training data than as a replacement, with modest improvements in classification performance, smaller gains in segmentation, and generally poorer performance with synthetic-only training. For researchers, developers, and regulators, these findings highlight the need for standardized multimethod image-quality evaluation, complete reporting, and rigorous external validation before synthetic-image pipelines are translated into clinical AI applications. Trial Registration: PROSPERO CRD42023369125; Results: A total of 160 studies were included.

item.title: Evaluating Large Language Model–Derived Outputs as Psychological Measures: A Five-Domain Psychometric Framework With Application to Daily Stress
item.description: Conclusions: Prediction metrics alone are insufficient for evaluating LLM-derived psychological measures. Measurement-oriented evaluation revealed properties, including level-dependent effects and asymmetric error attribution, that have direct implications for how LLM-based assessment studies interpret their results. For clinical use, the measure is a complement to existing screening instruments for longitudinal monitoring, not a stand-alone diagnostic. Results: Features showed high repeatability (mean intraclass correlation coefficient=0.987), construct-dependent convergent validity (Spearman ρ=0.08 to 0.79), and within-person tracking of same-day stress (negative emotion β=0.68).
